gloss: exceptional; unusual; out of the ordinary

definitions.gloss: exceptional; unusual; out of the ordinary
definitions.explanation: Deviating from the norm or standard rule. Describes something that is an exception to the general pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{例外的|れいがいてき}な⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧だ。
{例外的|れいがいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was permitted as an exception.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{例外的|れいがいてき}な⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As an exceptional measure, we will extend the deadline this time.

notes:
A な-adjective formed from ⟦{例外|れいがい}→例外：03798_reigai⟧ (exception) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (suffix making a na-adjective). Describes something that does not follow the usual rule or pattern.

USAGE:
- As a modifier: {例外的|れいがいてき}な + noun (e.g., {例外的|れいがいてき}な⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: exceptional treatment)
- As an adverb: {例外的|れいがいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (exceptionally, as an exception)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {例外的|れいがいてき}な⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: exceptional measure
- {例外的|れいがいてき}な⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: exceptional treatment
- {例外的|れいがいてき}な⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧: exceptional case
- {例外的|れいがいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to approve as an exception

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧: special — broader meaning, not necessarily about breaking a rule
- ⟦{異例|いれい}→異例：13564_irei⟧: unprecedented, unusual — emphasizes rarity and deviation from custom
- ⟦{特殊|とくしゅ}→特殊：04566_tokushu⟧: special, peculiar — emphasizes uniqueness of a specific situation
